_comment: Mirrors ~/.config/markdownlint-cli/.markdownlint.json, which the pre-commit hook uses only when a repo has no root config of its own. This file exists so tests/regression/ fixtures can be linted: they are raw prose samples under test, and MD041's required H1 would corrupt the sample text. MD041 is off repo-wide because markdownlint-cli resolves config at the invocation, not per directory, so a nested config in tests/regression/ is not honored. Keep the rest in sync with the global file.
